nodes.label: Car Headlight Macro Photo
nodes.rationale: Dramatic macro close-up of a modern LED projector headlight with white DRL strip and amber/orange accent light on a pure black background; moody, premium, tech-detail feel. Likely a decorative hero/section background or feature-detail visual.

nodes.label: Executive Sedan Photo
nodes.rationale: Black BMW 7 Series-style executive sedan in a dark showroom with warm orange LED cove lighting and reflective stone floor; luxurious, moody. Likely a category card or listing/hero image for sedans.

nodes.label: Luxury SUV Photo
nodes.rationale: Dark grey Cadillac Escalade-style full-size luxury SUV in a dark studio with an orange vertical light slit; premium, cinematic. Likely a category card or hero image for SUVs.

nodes.label: Hero Car Image
nodes.rationale: Dark, cinematic studio shot of a matte-black luxury grand-tourer sports coupe (Aston Martin-style front grille and LED headlights) with orange rim lighting on wet reflective floor and angular concrete walls. Lots of empty dark space on the right for overlay text; likely the homepage hero/banner background.

nodes.label: Interior Cockpit Image
nodes.rationale: Night-time view of a modern car interior: black leather seats, steering wheel, infotainment touchscreen, carbon-fiber console trim and orange ambient LED strips, with a city skyline through the windshield. Likely used for a features/comfort/interior section.

nodes.label: Quality Engine Image
nodes.rationale: Macro close-up of a forged-carbon/carbon-ceramic drilled brake disc and glossy orange brake caliper behind a carbon-fiber wheel spoke. Despite the filename, it shows brakes not an engine. Likely used for a quality/inspection or performance-assurance section.

nodes.label: Coastal Road Night Drive Photo
nodes.rationale: Rear view of a dark luxury coupe-SUV with a glowing orange full-width taillight, driving on a curved coastal mountain road at dusk under dramatic clouds, with town lights reflected on the sea. Moody, cinematic, motion-blurred; likely a hero/banner or lifestyle section image evoking performance and freedom.

nodes.label: Safe Delivery Inspection Bay Photo
nodes.rationale: Front view of a glossy black luxury SUV centered in a dark, high-tech inspection/prep bay with overhead light panels, orange floor guide lines, tool cabinets and a diagnostic monitor. Clean, premium, trustworthy mood; likely illustrates a safe delivery / pre-delivery inspection service section.

nodes.label: Free Zone Waterfront Showroom Photo
nodes.rationale: Modern glass-walled two-level car showroom at dusk lit with warm orange lighting, displaying several SUVs, beside a wet waterfront promenade with port cranes in the background. Suggests a free-trade-zone/port showroom; likely used for an about/location or import section.

nodes.label: graphify skill (project-local)
nodes.rationale: Project-local graphify skill at .claude/skills/graphify/SKILL.md, triggered by /graphify

nodes.label: GRAPH_REPORT.md
nodes.rationale: Read only for broad architecture review

nodes.label: graphify query/path/explain workflow
nodes.rationale: Scoped subgraph queries are much smaller than reading GRAPH_REPORT.md or raw grep output, so prefer them for codebase questions

nodes.label: graphify update (AST-only rebuild)
nodes.rationale: Run after modifying code to keep graph current with no API cost; graph.json is rewritten whole so large diffs are expected and not churn

nodes.label: Uploads route handler /uploads/[...path]
nodes.rationale: Next.js production only serves public/ files present at build time; route handler serves runtime uploads and lets UPLOAD_DIR point to a persistent path outside the project

nodes.label: /admin/dashboard (empty content area)
nodes.rationale: Intentionally empty as base for future modules

nodes.label: middleware.ts auxiliary /admin guard
nodes.rationale: Only blocks when cookie is absent; never the sole authorization mechanism

nodes.label: requireAdmin() server guard
nodes.rationale: Server is authoritative: decodes token and verifies admin exists in DB on every request

nodes.label: prisma/seed.mjs dev admin seeder
nodes.rationale: Idempotent; does not run in production

nodes.label: bcryptjs password hashing
nodes.rationale: cost 12; never store plaintext

nodes.label: jose JWT session (HS256)
nodes.rationale: Signed token in HttpOnly SameSite=Lax cookie, Secure in production

nodes.label: SIL Open Font License 1.1
nodes.rationale: Permits use, modification and redistribution as long as fonts are not sold by themselves

nodes.label: Vazirmatn Persian font
nodes.rationale: Persian typeface suited to the RTL UI

nodes.label: Verification results (typecheck, build, 21 headless browser checks)
nodes.norm_label: verification results (typecheck, build, 21 headless browser checks)

nodes.label: .admin-root isolated design system
nodes.rationale: admin- prefixed tokens in globals.css so admin styling does not leak to public site; public nav/footer/dock not rendered under /admin

nodes.label: Admin authentication flow
nodes.rationale: Validate with zod + normalize Persian/Arabic digits, check Origin and rate limit, verify bcrypt hash against admins table, set signed JWT cookie

nodes.label: Generic login error + constant-time compare
nodes.rationale: Prevents user enumeration

nodes.label: Origin check in Server Action
nodes.rationale: Extra defense layer beyond Next.js default check

nodes.label: package.json#prisma seed deprecation
nodes.rationale: Supported in Prisma 6, removed in Prisma 7; migrate to prisma.config.ts

nodes.label: In-memory login rate limiting
nodes.rationale: 5 failures in 10 min locks 15 min; per-process so must move to shared store like Redis for multi-instance deploys
